calibration_note: v2 signed off 2026-08-20 by the project owner. Basis: Q4 2025 (2025-12-31) is the first quarter through the full remediation cycle; v1 provisional ship-bars were set 2026-07-12 with one wave of evidence and the contract then read FAIL (verified_fv 35.45, flagged 43.99); remediation waves earned PASS 7/7 with actuals reconcile_rate 95.5, flagged_fv_share 4.85, source_blocking 0.164, verified_fv_share 80.5. v2 tightens to bars the Q4 actuals clear with honest headroom: reconcile_rate 70->90 (tolerates ~6 escalated funds of ~66 anchored without incentivizing forced reconciliation), flagged_fv_share 20->10, source_blocking_fv_share 5->1, verified_fv_share 50->70. fund_coverage, rule drift/health, and assessability unchanged. Owner proviso: Q1 2026 (2026-03-31) and Q2 2026 (2026-06-30) passes may be used to recalibrate further; record any v3 basis here. Prior v1 note (2026-07-12): set from post-Wave-1 observables; provisional ship-bar values, not validated tolerances. v3 (2026-09-07, provisional): numerator moved to the PUBLISHED basis (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-07-published-basis-conservation-gate-design.md); two checks added -- over_inclusion_fv_share <= 0.5 and unfinished_investigations <= 0. Q1 2026 re-run under v3 is EXPECTED to fail both FV-share checks; that result is the proof the gate sees the $4.09B over-inclusion, not a regression. Calibrate to v4 on Q2 2026 actuals.
